Neither day was chain-through-the-print (the chain into both prints was DOWN: 0429 close 2.638 into 0430; 0506 close 2.714 into 0507), so the over-extension gate does not fire - these were COUNTER-print reversals. The explanatory read is the ph1 aligned buy-flow+up delivery (0430 +670 on +1964 sflow; 0507 +800 on +554 sflow) followed by a ph2 covering signature (0430 price +650 while sflow -2822 = sell absorbed under rising price; 0507 price flat while sflow -1105 = sell absorbed, held). The working discriminator is signed-flow-vs-price CONVICTION per phase: aligned ph1 earns the band; ph2 negative-flow-under-non-falling price is a COVERING rally to be RIDDEN, not a fade. The whole-day move is derivable as the phase px sum on both days (0430 -90+670+650=+1230; 0507 -80+800+0=+720), which is measurable causal state, not a fit.
